output_text:
answer: Rig grounding off Lewis due to storm, 300m exclusion zone; salvage team inspecting 280-ton diesel oil rig.
evidence: ["The rig ran aground off Lewis during a storm on Monday while being transported to Malta. Sightseers have been warned to stay away from the scene of the grounding, and a 300m temporary exclusion zone has been put in place around Dalmore beach.", "A salvage team began an inspection of the structure on Tuesday in preparation for the more detailed assessment."]
